newsitem.title: USA: Fire hits jazz great Hampton's New York apartment.
newsitem.headline: Fire hits jazz great Hampton's New York apartment.

text.p: Fire broke out Tuesday in jazz great Lionel Hampton's high-rise apartment, causing several minor injuries, authorities said.

The New York Fire Department reported the blaze began in the 28th-floor apartment when a halogen lamp fell onto a bed. The fire spread rapidly and forced partial evacuation of the 42-story building, located near Lincoln Centre for the Performing Arts.
Hampton, 88, was not hurt. He told NBC television, "The lamp started cooking. I was in the living room ... If it had been two minutes later, I would have been cooking myself."

The blaze was first reported at 2:30 p.m. EST in the building known as One Lincoln Plaza, the Fire Department said. A complete count of the injured was not available, but the department said most involved smoke inhalation.
